title: Name things in reconcile for what they are
description: `current`, `known`, `level` and `delta` read fine when reconcile was twenty lines; now that it has batches and the unknown list, half the locals need a second look to remember which side of the sync they belong to. This renames them for the warehouse side they come from (`existing`, `heldByKey`, `held`) and what the difference means (`shortfall`), and gives the key helper a name that says what it keys. Same treatment for the summary's loop. No tests needed changing beyond the name of the fake warehouse.

commit.subject: Name things in reconcile for what they are
commit.body:
existing, heldByKey, held, shortfall, levelKey; the summary's loop to
match; the test's fake warehouse is `stock`.
